load across the whole network.

the third one is the one that I told you

this video, and it's one that catches

primary cellular repair and detox
processes. Your liver is one of the most
active organs during this window,
clearing inflammatory compounds,
rebalancing hormones, and repairing
damaged cells. When sleep is
consistently poor or too short, that

8 hours of sleep consistently, and going

is the most underreported liver threat
on this entire list. The fourth thing
destroying your liver are microplastics
and other endocrine-disrupting
chemicals. BPA and phthalates, chemicals
found in plastic food containers, water

packaging, leach into food and water

heated. Once inside your body, they
travel directly to the liver for
processing. Here's what makes them so

endocrine disruptors. They mimic and

particularly estrogen and thyroid
hormones. Your liver is responsible for

When it gets flooded with
hormone-mimicking chemicals daily, it

liver inflammation, impaired fat

progression. Research published in the

independently associated with elevated

never heat food in plastic. Always

Switch to a stainless steel or glass
water bottle. You want to put leftovers

and choose fresh or frozen food over
canned food wherever possible. The fifth

one of the primary mechanisms behind
NAFLD in people who eat relatively well,

fat, and you want to break up your
